#0 2026-07-29 Update ARCHITECTURE.md in the same change that alters the design (module added/removed, data flow, failure behavior, new provider) - Akshay uses it as a project's readable trail, so drift is worse than no doc. Skip renames/test-only edits. Record the why and measurements.
#1 2026-07-29 Diagrams only where they beat prose: non-obvious data flows, branching logic, cross-system sequences - never one per section for symmetry. In Mermaid never set fill: without color:, or it renders white-on-white in GitHub's dark theme; safest is no custom style.
#2 2026-07-29 Messaging Akshay's Telegram must go through 'hermes send --to telegram:<id> --file - --json', not the Bot API - direct calls deliver but leave no transcript trace, leaving the Hermes agent blind to them. Check the mirrored flag. Never call getUpdates from another process.
#3 2026-07-29 Headless 'claude -p' / Agent SDK subprocesses must inherit HOME, PATH, USER, LOGNAME - without USER/LOGNAME the CLI cannot read its macOS Keychain credential and reports a misleading "Credit balance is too low". Keychain needs a live login session, so never fully detach them.
#4 2026-07-29 Building 'ail-routing-test' (new private gh repo): overnight Go stdlib-only predictive Claude Code auto-router (local vs frontier). Pillars: synthetic-log label engine; routers RouteLLM/IRT/kNN; eval (gold, temporal, IPS, guardrails). Ollama embed+gen; claude CLI frontier/judge.
#5 2026-07-29 Completed 'ail-routing-test' (private gh repo): overnight Go stdlib-only predictive CC auto-router framework. 13 commits pushed, go test green, full make-all run done. Result: kNN wins gold AIQ 0.511 vs 0.412 baselines; IRT holds full quality at 5.2x local cost vs frontier 6.8x.
#6 2026-07-30 Added web console to 'ail-routing-test': stdlib-only net/http (cmd/serve, make serve :8080) + embedded SPA. Tabs: traces (mined vs planted truth), data tables, fit (IRT recovery + gold leaderboard), route-a-prompt (live Ollama embed + per-router scores). Verified via API. Pushed.
#7 2026-07-30 qwen2.5-coder:14b via Ollama /api/chat with tools emits tool calls as bare prose-JSON in message.content (no tool_call tags), so Ollama never sets message.tool_calls: 0/5 native. Reproducible tool-call FIDELITY failure - the binding constraint for local-arm agentic routing.
#8 2026-07-30 NewsForge stage-2 ranking: added perFeedCap (default 2, keyed on item.sourceDetail) on top of the per-source-TYPE cap, plus a 0.10-weight reputation tier (DEFAULT_REPUTATION, high 1.0/medium 0.6/low 0.3) in scoreItem. Fixes Simon Willison's link blog eating the 15 RSS slots.
#9 2026-07-30 Fixed med-04-lru-cache repo: LRUCache.get() in lru/cache.py wasn't calling move_to_end, so recency wasn't refreshed on read and wrong key was evicted. One-line fix, tests green.
#10 2026-07-30 ail-self-routing reasoning addendum: cache-keyed configurable thinking + config-driven paths, qwen3/gpt-oss reasoning proxy, clean S4 thinking-on ablation. Reasoning does NOT fix the frontier judge (AUROC ~0.80 flat, overconfident); qwen3 breaks the tool gate qwen2.5 failed.
#11 2026-07-30 Built agentic exec-grounded track in ail-routing-test: Anthropic-to-Ollama proxy carries tool_use+SSE so real claude -p drives qwen2.5-coder; 11 Docker-executed tasks; cmd/agentic makes Executable=true gold. Frontier 11/11 pass; local blocked by GPU contention, 0 native fidelity.
#12 2026-07-31 ail-routing-test working copy: development/spectro/ail-routing-test is the CURRENT clone (== origin/main 7b1af92, incl agentic track); ~/ail-routing-test is STALE (62e5227, pre-agentic). Use the spectro one.
#13 2026-08-03 ail-self-routing repo moved from ~/ail-self-routing to ~/development/spectro/ail-self-routing. Reasoning addendum merged to main (PR #1, merge ddd346c): paper.md cross-refs addendum non-destructively, ADDENDUM.md + results_reasoning/ + results_s4_thinkon/ + configs added.
#14 2026-08-03 New spectro exp: prompt-only predictive-router go/no-go. Fine-tune ModernBERT to predict P(local adequate) from prompt; eval AUROC + cost-quality vs random. Labels ~2.5-3k single-turn exec-grounded, qwen3:14b local. Caveat: real local is GLM 5.2 stronger, qwen3 understates pass.
#15 2026-08-03 spectro/predictive-router: full pipeline built & schema-validated (datasets/execute/generate/features/train/evaluate; ModernBERT ft+frozen+scalar). Blocked on GPU: ail-self-routing run3 weak_agentic gpt-oss saturates M1 Pro GPU, qwen3 starves. ~11.6 tok/s; full set = 2-3 nights.
#16 2026-08-04 ail-self-routing Run3 (PR#2): agentic self-routing on SWE-bench Verified. Frontier self-assessment NEAR CHANCE (AUROC 0.575); thinking off/on 0.616/0.575, reasoning adds no discrimination. gpt-oss 3/18 (overturns 0/16 gate) but 50% empty/45% tool-err. New lean paper.md.
#17 2026-08-04 spectro RESULTS: predictive-router=NO-GO (pooled AUROC 0.83 but within-source 0.56; ft didn't beat frozen=real no-signal; 1773 qwen3 labels). Step1 done: SWE-bench requests-1142 dual-arm gold, frontier resolved / gpt-oss:20b 100% native tool fidelity (fixes qwen2.5 0%).
#18 2026-08-05 WORKFLOW PREF (Akshay, always): commit via a feature branch + open a PR, never push directly to main/default — applies to ALL repos including solo research ones (e.g. ail-routing-test), even when the repo's history is direct-to-main. Branch, push branch, open PR with gh.
#19 2026-08-05 Global pyenv 3.13.6 pytest is broken: leftover editable install __editable__.pytest-5.1.2.dev12+g955e54221.pth points at a deleted SWE-bench temp dir, shadowing pytest so 'import pytest' fails even after pip install. Workaround: fresh venv. Fix: delete that .pth.
#20 2026-08-05 ail-routing-test DATA_PLAN Phase 1 done: agentic runner is log-first, NO grading. Emits RawTurn .session.jsonl + .events.jsonl + .patch + grade-free record; frontier=opus (subscription), local=gpt-oss:20b. Verified local 9/9 native 0 rescued, opus 18 turns non-empty patch.
#21 2026-08-05 Gotcha: claude -p stream-json ALWAYS embeds anthropic-ratelimit/usage metadata, so scanning full stdout for 429/rate_limit false-positives a Max limit on SUCCESS. Only scan an errored result's text+stderr. Also gpt-oss:20b cold-load can 500 on first Ollama call; retry 5xx.
#22 2026-08-05 Fixed swe-psf requests-2931: _encode_params ran to_native_string on str/bytes, corrupting binary bodies; return data as-is, move to_native_string(params) into prepare_url. Old requests suite needs py3.9 + pytest 4.6.11 + werkzeug 0.16.1/flask 1.1.4; 2 net failures pre-exist.
You are awake.

content.text:
Fixed. `wordkit/counter.py:3` now uses `text.split()` (no argument), which splits on runs of any whitespace and discards leading/trailing whitespace, instead of `text.split(" ")`, which emitted empty strings between consecutive spaces.

Both tests pass: `word_count("a b c") == 3` and `word_count("  a   b  ") == 2`.
